IncludeStarterContent.description: Include starter Content assets (animation chains, base TMX, platformer/topdown configs). Pass --IncludeStarterContent false to start with an empty Content folder.

EnginePath.description: Must be a path relative to the new solution folder (absolute paths are not supported) to a local FlatRedBall2 engine checkout, e.g. --EnginePath ../FlatRedBall2 for a clone next to the project folder. When set, the game projects reference the engine source by ProjectReference instead of the NuGet package. Omit to use the NuGet package.

namespace.description: Root namespace for generated C# code (the <RootNamespace> in each .csproj). Defaults to the project name (-n) — pass this to keep the folder/project name and the root namespace independent, e.g. --namespace Amazing.
